_comment: Generated from `harbor run --print-config`, so the schema is Harbor's own.
Run it with: harbor run --config dataset/harbor-job.json --plugin langsmith ...
Two settings here exist because of specific failures, not preference:
jobs_dir  — outside the repo. With the default ./jobs, `project_path` of
the repo root makes shutil.copytree recurse into its own
reason plus a much smaller upload.
Not expressible here, so they stay CLI flags:
--ae ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=...  Harbor forwards ANTHROPIC_API_KEY but NOT
the base URL, so a gateway key 401s.
--env-file .env              the harbor CLI does not read .env itself.
